program.name: Heavy Complex EMOM
program.subject: Kettlebell complexes
program.blurb: A heavy complex in straight sets, then a complex on every minute.
program.about: Heavy first, then fast. Each day opens with a heavy complex in straight sets, a clean, press and squat or a swing, pull and push press, then an EMOM of three more complex moves. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for a heavier bell and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Heavy complex, then a complex EMOM, A / B
